title: Counter Hate Speech in Social Media: A Survey
benchmark_measurement: The paper surveys research that measures the prevalence of hate speech against religious groups and the effectiveness of counter-speech in those contexts. For example, it discusses work that analyzed discussions biased towards Islam and Muslims, and other work that collected data from communities including Jews.
findings: Religion is the most frequently studied topic in the field of Counter Hate Speech (CHS).
